title: Write unit tests for task reader.ts
description: Create comprehensive Vitest unit tests for the task reader module. Cover reading valid files, missing files, invalid JSON, schema validation failures, writing, and task status functions.
acceptanceCriteria: readTasks: valid file returns Task[] test passes
readTasks: missing file throws descriptive error test passes
readTasks: invalid JSON throws error test passes
readTasks: invalid schema throws ZodError test passes
writeTasks: writes correctly and can be re-read test passes
getIncompleteTasks: filters by passes:false test passes
markTaskComplete: sets passes:true for correct task test passes
npm test passes all reader.test.ts cases

steps.description: Create src/lib/tasks/reader.test.ts with temp dir setup
steps.details: Create the test file. Use Vitest's beforeEach/afterEach hooks with a temp directory: import { mkdtemp, rm } from 'fs/promises'; import { tmpdir } from 'os'. Create a fresh temp dir for each test to isolate file operations.
Test: (1) create valid tasks.json → readTasks returns array; (2) no tasks.json → throws with 'not found' message; (3) invalid JSON → throws; (4) wrong schema → throws ZodError.
Test: write a task array, then readTasks returns the same array. Verify the file has 2-space indentation.
Test: getIncompleteTasks with mixed tasks → only returns passes:false. markTaskComplete with valid ID → returns array with that task's passes set to true.
Run `npm test` and verify all reader.test.ts tests pass.

technicalNotes: Use tmp dirs for all file I/O tests — never write to the project's actual .agent/ during testing
Vitest supports afterEach for cleanup: await rm(tmpDir, { recursive: true })
